episodes.title: Episode 1
episodes.summary: Manager Kim, an ordinary middle-aged man who gets grabbed by the collar even by the neighborhood thugs. His estranged daughter Minji suddenly disappears just before her birthday. Manager Kim sets out to find Minji.

episodes.title: Episode 2
episodes.summary: Frantic to find where Min-ji is, Manager Kim uses his skills from his days as Agent Kim — a secret agent who specialized in ruthless enemy takedowns.

episodes.title: Episode 3
episodes.summary: Manager Kim reconnects with Sung Han-soo and Park Jin-cheol — his fellow dad friends (and former secret agents) — on his search for Min-ji.

episodes.title: Episode 4
episodes.summary: Manager Kim's risky actions put him on the radar of enemies past and present. When danger strikes, Han-soo and Jin-cheol step up to help save the day.

episodes.title: Episode 5
episodes.summary: Manager Kim trades blows with the enemy agent chasing him — only to realize he is an old friend. Meanwhile, Min-ji attempts an escape of her own.

episodes.title: Episode 6
episodes.summary: Min-ji finds herself in a dire situation — until special agent Jung Sang-a shows up. The Special Missions Directorate tries to lure out Manager Kim.

episodes.title: Episode 7
episodes.summary: Manager Kim and Min-ji finally reunite, but the path to safety is far from smooth. Later, Manager Kim is forced to make a difficult decision.

episodes.title: Episode 8
episodes.summary: Manager Kim is captured and tortured — until the Special Missions Directorate steps in with a final mission. Ju Gang-chan makes a plan to get revenge.

episodes.title: Episode 9
episodes.summary: As the inter-Korean talks faced the threat of collapse, Kim faced a desperate crisis under pressure from the special bureau led by Minji.

episodes.title: Episode 10
episodes.summary: Three people who go from comrades to enemies to protect their loved ones. Can they truly protect those who are precious?
